title: EASE SBS 5 (Efficacy And Safety Evaluation of Glepaglutide in Treatment of SBS)
official: A Phase 3, Double-Blind, Randomized, Parallel-Group, Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter Trial to Confirm the Efficacy and Safety of Glepaglutide 10 mg Twice-Weekly, Followed by a Long-Term, Open-Label Safety Evaluation in Patients with Short Bowel Syndrome–Intestinal Failure (SBS-IF)
summary: Main objective: To confirm the efficacy of glepaglutide 10 mg TW in patients with SBS-IF
